summary: GPB Automotive Portfolio, LP filed an 8-K disclosing it has sold substantially all assets and entered receivership by U.S. District Court (EDNY). The filing adopts a modified reporting approach, substituting Form 8-K for 10-K/10-Q by attaching a quarterly status report from the court-appointed Receiver for Q1 2026. No deal price or premium is stated. Epiq Corporate Restructuring serves as claims agent; investor claims are being solicited. This is a court-supervised liquidation of the partnership. Watch for status of distributions and final claims resolution timeline.
